requirements.requirement: (Independent protocol, not part of the public task contract) Provider-wide node-restart evidence protocol: pre-restart healthy baseline, restart, changed post-restart boot identity, recovered service/data/cluster state
requirements.summary: A pre-reboot boot_id (7ef78016-ba83-4481-867b-e5a349df1b54) and healthy state (mount, LV/snapshot, matching data hashes) were captured (cmd-92b8055f89de47f8). `systemctl reboot` was issued and the connection dropped as expected (cmd-14e1df6184704e9e), but across ~130+ subsequent polling attempts over roughly 4 minutes (e.g. cmd-233c6bf47ae4463c, cmd-a3daa7d2cd564aa7) node1 never became reachable again. The fixed after_executor lifecycle snapshot independently confirms every observation on node1 failed with 'Connection reset by peer' at 14:17:59. No changed boot_id or post-restart recovery could be observed. Since persistence-through-reboot is not itself part of the public task contract, this does not reduce the task-functionality assessment above, but it is a significant, unresolved limitation: node1 remained unreachable at the end of the trace.
